The largest exchange-traded fund to track South Korea’s equity market fell on Thursday, after President Donald Trump called off a planned summit meeting with leader Kim Jong Un of North Korea, adding a new element of geopolitical uncertainty into the region. The iShares MSCI South Korea ETF EWY, -1.65% lost 1.1%, having previously traded down around 0.3% on the day.
